name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the commanded box pickup. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) is the 'until the door has been opened once' ban on dropping the key while the door is closed, and it lifts at the first opening. Both clauses are hard. The machine rejects a closed-door drop made before the first opening, and after that opening the ban no longer applies.

texts: Pick up the target box in the other room (the mission's box is picked up at some point).
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: the key_lost event must not happen before door_open has been true.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&!key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u3
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u3, target_picked_up) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&!key_lost&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&!target_picked_up, u2) -> -10
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&target_picked_up, u2) -> -10
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u3, target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
